translations.web: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
translations.bsb: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
translations.kjv: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
translations.asv: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
